rows.en: ...we'd simply assumed on our own it was an enemy who wasn't much of a fighter...
But when we learned the boss's true identity, we were stunned.
Firepower, armor, mobility... It's a mobile suit that surpasses all common sense in every respect.
Its name is "The O."
The O!?
...The O, huh. That's one nasty enemy.
You know about it?
The O... So he's the one behind this Cube... That man can't be allowed to live...!!
The O... He's made himself a mere spectator, and he thinks of war as nothing but a game.
That's probably why he hasn't shown himself until now, too.
I see. He won't dirty his own hands; he just watches his throwaway pawns fight from on high.
He's unforgivable... He deserves death ten thousand times over.
That "power of miracles" bothers me too.
Yeah. Let's do everything we can to stop it.
All right! When you guys storm their stronghold, we'll pull off a diversion that'll knock 'em dead!
So go ahead and advance without worrying!
Deathscythe, there are still areas we have to bring under control, you know?
Oh, yeah, that's right.
We want to keep forces in hand for that as well.
One way or another, we're gonna end up with our hands full, huh.
It's fine. We can handle their headquarters by ourselves.
Then without further ado, I'd like to take you to the Ride Machine.
Oh-ho, now that's what I like to hear!
We've already moved the ship to the Ride Gate.
We've set it up so you can board the moment you get there.
You're still here? I figured you'd already headed for the Ride Gate...
Well now, time I got back to my real job too.
This is the Ride Gate.
The Ride Machine is already prepped. Do you want to board right away?
Then let's go together.
All right. I'll wait for you here.
This is the outside of the Cube, known as the "Ride Dungeon."
It's full of Minus Energy out here, so it's dangerous. Even heroes may not survive.
View the Ride Dungeon tutorial?
A strange presence can be felt...
A sensation that seems to echo straight into the brain...!!
What...? This pressure...!
This grating feeling... I don't like it...
What... is this...!? Are these... quantum brainwaves?
The Zero System...!? No, that's not it...
I've got... a bad feeling about this...
!? This presence... It's not a Yummy either... What is it?
Telepathy...? It's not from an Ultra Warrior...
What? What's going on?
There's something here!!
What...?
Three stakes...?
...!? There's someone inside!!
Three stakes...?
...!? There's someone inside!!
Three stakes...?
Hey!? There's somebody in there, dammit!?
Three stakes...?
...!? There's someone inside!!
Three stakes...?
...!? There's someone inside!!
Three stakes...?
...!? There's someone inside!!
...!! Life signs inside!?
Who is it? Who's in there...
Three stakes...?
...!? Someone's inside...!?
Three stakes...?
...!? There's someone inside!!
A strained voice came from inside the three stakes.
I am... RX...
Kamen Rider Black RX...
Ah... RX!? Are you all right!?
I'll save you right now!!
Waaagh!!
Kamen Rider Black RX!?
All right, I'll save you now!!
Whoa!!
That you, RX!? What the hell happened to ya, stuck in a place like that!!
All right, hang tight!! I'm gonna get ya outta there!!
Nwaaagh!!
You're a Kamen Rider too...!?
That's a Kamen Rider. If I remember right, he was called Kamen Rider Black RX.
All right, I'll save you now!!
Ugh...

notes.note: Continues Seravee's (Tieria, 'boku') briefing from story_036 #0.79, which ends on 'in other words...'; 'we' = Celestial Being/the base side.
Legacy mis-decodes: first word read as 'firepower', the verb as 'surpass', the noun as 'mobile suit'. Meaning is clear from context.

Speaker labels in 0247 #0.84-0.104 are unreliable (shifted/swapped; e.g. #0.91 is Tieria's catchphrase but labelled Deathscythe Hell, #0.96 addresses Deathscythe but is labelled Deathscythe Hell). Tone was set from content: #0.84-0.88 read as Zeta Gundam (Kamille, Scirocco's old foe), #0.91 Seravee, #0.94-0.95 Deathscythe Hell, #0.96 Sandrock, #0.97 Deathscythe Hell, #0.99/#0.102/#0.104 Cherudim, #0.101/#0.103 Seravee, #0.100 the party leader.
'That one' in the source refers to The O's pilot (glossary g=m), so 'That man'.
Legacy mis-decode: read as 'watching from on high' (takami no kenbutsu).
Tieria's signature line (banshi ni atai suru) rendered 'deserves death ten thousand times over' to stay recognisable.
'power of miracles' refers back to the miracle-producing technology in story_036 #0.73; story_036 is untranslated, so align wording there if it chose differently.
'bacchiri kimeru' = pull off perfectly; 'knock 'em dead' keeps Duo's breezy tone. Main keep (honmaru) rendered 'stronghold'.
Read as: we must also keep troops for the areas still to be secured (answering #0.96). Speaker likely Sandrock or Nu Gundam.
Legacy mis-decode: read as 'te-ippai' (hands full).
Legacy mis-decode: first word read as 'daijoubu'. Party leader replying that the team can take the HQ alone.
Legacy verb partly mis-decoded; read as 'take you / show you to the Ride Machine'.
Legacy mis-decode: first word read as 'ship' (fune).
Birth (Date): 'honbyou' = his real line of work, kept vague as 'real job'.
Unlabelled; Seravee continuing (boku-style 'kai?').
#0.1-0.2 unlabelled; kept impersonal as narration/party reaction since the speaker isn't settled.
00 term 'nouryoushiha' = quantum brainwaves.
#0.8-0.25 are party-leader variants of the same two lines; only the leader's pair plays. #0.13 is a rough-spoken leader (Momotaros/Ankh-type), #0.20 a Gundam leader.
Source has a mis-decoded mark in place of the space in 'Black RX'; rendered the full name 'Kamen Rider Black RX'.

#0.32-0.44 (and on into story_038) are leader-dependent reactions, all mislabelled 'Zero'. #0.32-0.34 a polite Rider ('-san' dropped per style), #0.38-0.40 Momotaros-style, #0.41-0.44 a non-Rider leader; #0.42 is someone in the party explaining who RX is (speaker unknown).

report: 80/80 rows. 0247 speaker labels are shifted/swapped; tone set from content (see notes). Legacy mis-decodes guessed at #0.82, #0.90, #0.99, #0.100, #0.101, #0.103. 0253 #0.32-0.44 leader variants all mislabelled Zero. #0.92 'power of miracles' must match story_036 #0.73 once translated. No new names; 'quantum brainwaves' (00 term) not in glossary.
